purpose: Test whether the externally specified DISP-0014 risk overlay remains useful when dispersion is measured from a point-in-time, survivorship-aware liquid Binance USDT universe instead of today's fixed BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP panel.
historical_candidate_source: all ordinary historical spot-USDT symbols programmatically discoverable from Binance public market data; later inactive/BREAK symbols are retained while historical daily rows exist

eligibility_at_date_t.completed_history_semantics: the most recent 240 calendar daily rows ending at t must all be present; cumulative old observations separated by a long gap do not qualify
eligibility_at_date_t.quote_volume_information: completed Binance 1d kline quote asset volume at t

dispersion: sample standard deviation across eligible symbols of trailing 20-day cumulative log return at t

risk_overlay.target_dispersion: expanding median of strictly earlier valid dynamic-universe dispersion values
risk_overlay.application: scale entire frozen V1 exposure; removed exposure becomes cash
risk_overlay.lookahead: none; completed-day t information sets target for t+1

interpretation_rule: The decisive comparison is dynamic-universe DISP0015 versus both baseline and fixed-panel DISP0014. Do not tune liquidity, age, smoothing, floor or dispersion horizon after seeing results. Positive performance validates the dispersion risk mechanism more strongly; failure suggests fixed-panel selection/survivorship may explain part of DISP0014.
scope_caveat: This validates the dispersion risk signal only. Frozen V1 alpha still selects a fixed BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP set and therefore retains its own asset-selection bias; a separate dynamic-alpha experiment is required later.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: no adding market-cap estimates or current survival filters after first model run
